summary: Steel lookout on Quinault Indian Reservation land, built about 1937; taken down for scrap in 2011 or 2012; footings remain and access needs a permit.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says built in the 1930s, which fits the May 1937 construction account; firelookout.com says the 1940s. Record and story use 1937 construction.
90 ft per FFLOS, firelookout.com and the 1954 USGS description; the May 1937 article said an 80 foot tower. Sources do not reconcile; story gives both.
2011 per FFLOS and WillhiteWeb; 2012 per firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts site. Story reports both.
1,173 ft (358 m) per FFLOS and firelookout.com; WillhiteWeb gives 1,178 feet. Record keeps 357.5 m.

notes_for_editor: Construction decade, height, removal year and elevation all differ across sources; the story reports the conflicts. Site is on Quinault tribal land and the WillhiteWeb page says a permit may be needed, so the story advises asking first. Photo captions (1996, 2003, 2022) were not recorded as photos because no image URLs were read. The 1937 newspaper text was read only as quoted on two sites; the original paper was not checked.
